title: Walk In | Thermal Power Plants | India & Overseas | 6 To 15+ Yrs Exp.
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 11 Oct
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Hotel Swosti Grand, Unit-3, 103, Janpath Raod, near Railway Station, Master Canteen Area, Kharvela Nagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751001.
Contact: M Viswanath Reddy (9154019180)

About Nava: 
 Nava Limited, a 50+ year old listed company with a global footprint of diverse businesses across Asia and Africa, and a frontrunner in Power Generation, Ferro Alloys manufacturing, Mining, Agribusiness & Emerging Businesses is looking for the following incumbents for their Indian and Overseas business operations . 
 Walk-In positions : 
 1. Electrical Operations - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Electrical with 6-15 years of experience in operation of above 200KV switchyard, 6.6KV & 400 volts switchgear to meet the requirement for electrical system. 
 2. Boiler Desk Operations - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Mechanical with 6-15 years of experience in operation of Boiler as per load requirement and continuous monitoring of CEMS and other critical parameters. 
 3. Turbine Desk Operations - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Mechanical with 6-15 years of experience in operation of Turbine(s) and their auxiliaries. 
 4. Boiler & its Auxiliaries, DCS - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Electronics & Instrumentation with 6-15 years and responsible for DCS, PLC, and all C&I of Boiler, Turbine & its auxiliaries & Water System. 
 5. Turbine & its auxiliaries - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Electronics & Instrumentation with 6-15 years and responsible for DCS, PLC, and all C&I of Boiler, Turbine & its auxiliaries & Water System. 
 6. Boiler & its auxiliaries (Ash Handling System, Compressed Air System, Fuel Oil System, Waste-Water Treatment System ) - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Mechanical with 6-15 years of experience in boiler and its auxiliary maintenance, including Fuel Feeding System, Ash Handling System, Feed Control Stations and HP Valves. 
 7. Turbine & its auxiliaries and Water System - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Mechanical with 6-15 years of experience in Maintenance of the equipment in TG Building, TG and its auxiliaries, HVAC System and Water System. 
 8. Turbine, Generator, Switchgear & auxiliaries - Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Electrical with 6-15 years of experience in maintenance of the equipment in TG Building, Switchgear & auxiliaries. 
 9. BTG, BOP, High Voltage Switchyard, Switchgear & Auxiliaries Diploma / B.Tech / BE - Electrical with 6-15 years of experience to oversee day-to-day erection, testing and commissioning on the construction site and ensure work is executed according to project plans, drawings and specifications. 
 Experience: 6-15 years in Thermal Power Plants (Super Critical / Sub-critical Power Plant) of single unit capacity of 150 MW and above. Experience in CFBC Boilers is an added advantage; however, this is not an essential requirement. 
 Interested candidates whose profile matches the above requirements are requested to attend the walk-in scheduled from 9.30 AM to 5.30 PM on 11th October 2026 (Sunday) at Hotel Swosti Geand, Unit-3,Janpath Road, Bhubaneswar,Odisha, India . Please bring along updated bio-data, all relevant & education certificates, a passport-size photograph and the last three months' payslips. 
 Candidates who are unable to attend the walk-in may share their updated CV to viswanath.m@navalimited.com and careers@navalimited.com 
 Candidates with prior experience in the execution of Thermal Power Projects of 100MW capacity & above will be an added advantage. 
 Candidates who have attended interview with Nava Limited & Group companies within the last six (6) months are requested not to attend this Walk-In Drive.

Key Skills: Electrical Maintenance,Power Plant,Control Room Operation,Mechanical Maintenance,Instrumentation Maintenance,Boiler,Btg,DCS
